## Primitive set

List and define the proposed primitives.

## Target problem domain

What class of systems is this intended to cover?

## Mapping examples

Show how the grammar handles at least three materially different cases.

## Comparison with ART

Where does ART introduce redundancy, ambiguity, or unnecessary structure?

## Comparison with J/D/T/V

If relevant, show whether Judgment / Delegation / Termination / Verification can be reduced or replaced.

## Information preservation

What relevant information does the alternative preserve or lose?

## Implementation evidence

If possible, provide a working design, prototype, schema, protocol, or real deployment.

## Expected research consequence

What should ART change if this alternative performs better?
